nodes.label: Reduced Motion Accessibility Pattern
nodes.rationale: useReducedMotion from framer-motion is queried once at the App root and passed as a prop to every section and UI component, ensuring animations are skipped for users with prefers-reduced-motion enabled. This avoids repeated media queries deep in the tree and keeps accessibility handling centralized.

nodes.label: Ardor Design System (Color + Font Tokens)
nodes.rationale: Custom Tailwind tokens (ardor.red, ardor.gold, ardor.copper, ardor.dark, etc.) and font families (cormorant, montserrat, mono) encode the brand identity at the CSS utility level, allowing consistent theming across all components without inline style repetition. Cinema easing curve and marquee/shimmer keyframes are defined here to stay synchronized.

nodes.label: Vite Manual Chunk Strategy
nodes.rationale: Three.js, postprocessing, framer-motion, lucide-react, and react are split into separate named chunks so that heavy 3D libraries do not block the initial React paint. Visitors who never scroll to the 3D section still benefit from a lighter first bundle.

nodes.label: Blur-to-Sharp Reveal Pattern
nodes.description: Adding blur to entry animations creates a cinematic 'focus pull' feel that aligns with the futuristic fine-dining aesthetic. The blur prop defaults true so all existing Reveal consumers get the upgrade automatically.

nodes.label: Warm Palette Rationale (Tone-Down)
nodes.description: Electric teal (#6FF7E5) was removed from the design system because high-saturation cool accents read as 'sci-fi sports brand' rather than 'fine-dining house'. Replaced with warm burgundy (#A8323F) and brushed brass (#C9A961) to cue warmth, restraint, and confidence.

nodes.label: Custom i18n Context Rationale
nodes.description: No third-party i18n library (react-i18next, FormatJS) was used because the project is small enough for a custom Context with a simple dot-path lookup. This avoids bundle weight while keeping the architecture extensible for future languages.

nodes.label: ContainerScroll JSX Port Rationale
nodes.description: The ContainerScroll component was ported from 21st.dev TSX to JSX rather than installed as a package, removing TypeScript dependency and keeping the bundle lean. No new dependencies were added beyond what was already in package.json.

nodes.label: Procedural 3D Dish Fallback Rationale
nodes.description: A procedural placeholder paella is rendered when no dish.glb is present so dev work is never blocked by missing assets. The real model should be Draco/Meshopt-compressed to under 1 MB.
